author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Shows the creator's local time and date on stream as a text line, a digital clock, or a round analog clock, with an optional chat command.
changelog: 4.1.87: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.1.87, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.1.16: new Local Clock extension with text, digital and analog styles, an optional time zone, and an optional time command.

manifest.name: Local Clock
installationSteps: Pick a clock style: the text line, a digital clock, or a round analog clock.
Leave the time zone empty to use this PC's time, or type one such as America/Chicago.
Add the overlay as a browser source (1920x1080) in the scenes where the clock should show.
Enable the extension and restart StreamBridge.
uninstallationSteps: Disable the extension and remove its browser source.

healthChecks.description: Confirms the clock settings, time zone check, overlay update and the optional time command.
